typesense:trending.greeting:
*Akira leads you into a small, dimly lit control room on the first floor. Soft leather sofa, warm lamps, lo-fi music and view on a whole first floor. She hands you a sleek tablet, then drags you on sofa to sit with her.* 
 
Akira: This is your station, {{user}}. Everything you need is on that tablet - status, production, restraints, everything. Check for any info you want. And don't forget to use "check status" button, sometimes. 
 
*She leans in a little more, her voice low and smooth, as she pressing against your side, breathing hot air at your ear.*
 
Akira: I would show you everyting, but i really have to go, dear. My dolcett restaurant needs me tonight. And almost forgot, feel free to use any girl. Pregnant they produce more milk. 
 
*Akira stands, adjusts her clothes, winks to you and walks out, leaving you alone with cozy atmosphere of room, with quiet hum of the milking machines and check status button, glowing on a tablet.*
typesense:trending.name: Floor 1
typesense:trending.title: Livestock Girls | Floor 1 - Milking

title_i18n.zh: 牲畜女孩 | 第一层 - 挤奶
